name: GENISOM AI
summary: GENISOM AI, also known as Zhishen Technology, develops embodied intelligence robots, motion control and integrated joint modules. Established in December 2023, the company operates in Beijing and Suzhou. Its product portfolio includes industrial quadrupeds and the Yin Yi NE01 humanoid. GENISOM combines in-house robot hardware, core components and software for research, inspection, emergency response and entertainment applications.
